services.name: Island Tours & Sunset Cruises
services.desc: Experience the beautiful beaches of North Carolina while cruising the vast waterways along our coast. The most remote beaches in North Carolina are only accessible by boat and are preserved for wildlife. White sand, gorgeous Caribbean-like gin clear water awaits you and your friends and family. Take a tour to discover your remote spot on a beach away from the crowds. We can hop around the intracoastal exploring different sandbars among our dynamic inlet systems. We can search for seashells, sharks teeth, coquina, and more. services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Louisiana is home to some of the best red fishing in the world. The marsh just south of New Orleans is an abundant wetland that make up an excellent habitat for our primary targeted species, Redfish. During the winter months in Southeastern Louisiana, Large Bull Redfish push inshore for warmth and food. This time also happens to be when the water can get very clear making it an excellent time to sight fish with fly rods and light tackle. If you are looking for a trophy red fish, Black Drum, or Sheepshead on a fly rod, Louisiana is the destination to make it happen. quotes.author: Harper Hancock
quotes.text: Harper Hancock01:02 24 May 24Just wrapped up two days of fishing with Jeff and cannot say enough about how truly exceptional a guide this dude is. He set us up with shots at fish from bell to bell both days. Sealed the deal on a handful of quality reds with his guidance. He is both fishy and personable as hell (these two are often mutually exclusive). Runs a top notch skiff that he poles with a deftness that only comes with a whole lot of time on the platform. Dude has a fire in him for what he does and it so clearly shows. Can't wait to fish him again.

quotes.author: Brian Thompson
quotes.text: Brian Thompson12:47 10 Oct 23When we arrived, Jeff was fully prepared and greeted us warmly. He was friendly, professional and clearly knowledgeable. He worked well with my 18 year old son and we became fast friends. We caught several fish, including the largest flounder I have ever caught as well and largest Red Drum my son has ever caught. We have been on several fishing charters, however afterwards my son and I agreed it was the best fishing experience we have ever had to date by far. Thanks Jeff. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: Logan Crawford
quotes.text: Logan Crawford20:32 22 Aug 24Capt Jeff is super knowledgeable of the area, ecosystem and history of the area. Laid back, but driven to make sure the experience is well worth it!Been on a couple charter style ocean trips in various areas and by far this has been my favorite one. Different fishing styles and if one spot isn't working there's already another you're heading to.10/10 would recommend and would love to go again!

quotes.author: Matthew Holmes
quotes.text: Matthew Holmes20:24 07 Jul 2410 out 10, will go again. Son and I had a blast on Jeff’s flats boat searching for redfish. He’s knowledgeable and patient, genuinely felt like he wanted us to catch fish. Kinda felt like fishing with a long time friend. Have been with other guides that I could tell it was just their job, not Jeff. Texted him randomly and he took us out on a day he originally had blocked out. Good times.

quotes.author: Brian Hochman
quotes.text: Brian Hochman00:03 08 Sep 24We had an amazing day with Jeff. We moved to many spots to find the fish and find the fish we did! Several nice drum and as many trout as we could bring. Jeff proved to be a very knowledgeable guide and knew where to take us. He was a pleasure to fish with as well.

quotes.author: shaina brockway
quotes.text: shaina brockway20:13 22 Aug 24Had a great time! We caught a good variety of fish and tried different fishing methods. Cap. Jeff also was super knowledgeable about the history and fishing in general. Felt like we went out with a good friend! Would definitely do it again! 😁
